# Scenario data: a synthetic Ljubljana morning built from the research

File: [`scenario/ljubljana_scenario.json`](scenario/ljubljana_scenario.json). Companion: [SURGE_EVENTS.md](SURGE_EVENTS.md), [LJUBLJANA_FLEET_AND_TEAMS.md](LJUBLJANA_FLEET_AND_TEAMS.md), [GAPS_STATUS.md](GAPS_STATUS.md).

**Everything here is synthetic.** No real patient data. Real numbers are used only for sizes, rules and sites, and each one carries its source.

**Tags:** **[S]** sourced, **[A]** assumption I made, **[G]** generated by the seeded script.

---

## 1. What the file contains

| Section | What | Engine-compatible? |
|---|---|---|
| `meta` | Date (Mon 23 Nov 2026), window 06:00 to 14:00 local (UTC+1), seed, sizing notes, assumptions | n/a |
| `places` (22) | The team's 20 seed places with identical ids and coordinates, plus the two real ambulance outposts (Vrhnika, Ivančna Gorica) | **Yes**, validated against `backend/app/models.py` `Place` |
| `vehicles` (14) | 12 emergency ambulances (NRV) + 2 sanitary vehicles | **Yes**, validated against `Vehicle` |
| `trips` (48) | 16 emergency, 16 urgent, 16 scheduled | **Yes**, validated against `Trip` |
| `extensions` | Helicopter, duty roster, reserve vehicles, hospital capacity, equipment tasks, organ task, organ time limits, extra helipads, timing rules (handover, replacement vehicle, cleaning, breaks, fuel, monthly demand) | **No**, the engine has no such concepts today |

The engine-compatible parts were checked by importing the team's pydantic models read-only: 22/22 places, 14/14 vehicles, 48/48 trips valid, no broken references, every `due_by` after `pickup_after`. I did **not** run the simulator on it; only the schema was validated.

## 3. How it relates to the team's existing seed

| | Team seed (`backend/app/sim/seed.py`) | This scenario |
|---|---|---|
| Ambulances | 3 | 12 |
| Transport vans | 5 | 2 |
| Trips | 24, all `scheduled` at start | 48, a mix of `emergency`, `urgent`, `scheduled` |
| Places | 20 | the same 20 + 2 outposts |
| Emergencies | arrive only as events | **also present at the start**, so the baseline is already busy |
| Helicopter | no | yes (extension) |
| Crews, shifts | no | yes (extension) |
| Hospital capacity | no | yes (extension, synthetic) |
| Equipment, organ | no | yes (extension) |

The team's seed models a **patient-transport fleet** (mostly dialysis, discharges, outpatient visits) with 8 vehicles. This scenario is closer to the **real emergency station** (12 NRV teams, a third of work is life-threatening). Both can coexist: the scenario's ids and coordinates match the seed, so a vehicle subset gives the demo size. A 1:3 demo cut would be 4 NRV + 1 van + a helicopter and about a third of the trips.

---

## 4. What the engine cannot represent today (not changed by me)

These are the gaps between the scenario and `backend/app/models.py`. The code belongs to the teammates; I have not changed it. This is a list for you to raise with them.

| Concept | Why it matters | Where the data is |
|---|---|---|
| `VehicleType` has only `ambulance` and `transport` | The challenge has helicopters (200 km/h, straight line, one patient, daylight only) | `extensions.helicopter` |
| `PlaceKind` has no helipad or airfield | Helicopters land at specific sites, UKC rooftop pad needs ground crew | `extensions.places_extra` |
| No crews or shifts | 12 h shifts, call-in, sick crews | `extensions.duty_roster` |
| No hospital capacity | "Reduced hospital capacity" is an event in the brief; real dispatch keeps a record of capacities | `extensions.hospital_capacity` |
| No equipment tasks | Equipment in a broken vehicle must be collected first (brief) | `extensions.equipment_tasks` |
| No organ tasks | Hard deadline from cold-ischaemia limit | `extensions.organ_task` |
| Events lack fog, priority change, capacity, mass casualty, helipad out, comms | See SURGE_EVENTS.md | `scenario/surge_events.json` |
| Routing is straight-line times a road factor | OSRM samples exist in `research/samples/` | n/a |

---

## 5. Using it

- **Read it:** plain JSON, UTF-8, Slovenian characters preserved.
- **Check it again:** the generator is a seeded Python script (`SEED = 20261123`); I kept it outside the repo because it is throwaway. If you want it committed, say so and I will put it under `research/`.
- **Rebase times:** the engine starts its clock at "now". Shift every time in the file by one offset so that 06:00 local becomes your simulated start.
- **Do not use as real data.** Hospital capacity is invented; shift start hours, base distribution, the organ arrival deadline and degraded-radio intervals are assumptions.
